FOMC minutes confirmed no rate cuts until Q2 2027 with September hike probability jumping to 68.8%, a structural hawkish repricing that fundamentally changes the discount rate for long-duration AI assets. BTC Gate 2 ($62,000 UTC midnight floor) is under immediate risk at ~$61,963; June CPI on July 14 is the next regime-defining binary. Morning call graded substantially WRONG on direction, capping conviction at medium.

bear_case: The FOMC minutes confirmed a structural repricing that markets were not fully pricing: no rate cuts until Q2 2027 with a September hike at 68.8% probability represents 'higher for longer, potentially higher' — a framework that compresses P/E multiples for the AI-infrastructure complex (NVDA at ~$203 implies 22x+ forward P/E) and zero-coupon crypto assets simultaneously. The dual-gate's survival by 22 SPX points and 0.10 VIX units was the thinnest possible margin, and it survived only because of a single idiosyncratic positive catalyst (China H200 approval) that may not repeat. Forward risk: June CPI arrives July 14 against a backdrop of Brent crude averaging $72+ in June's final weeks — higher than the $66-70 average assumed in prior CPI models — threatening a print ≥4.0% that would simultaneously validate the September hike and break both dual-gate thresholds. BTC's UTC midnight close near Gate 2 adds a second simultaneous breach risk before CPI. If SPX falls below 7,460 with VIX above 17 on any session before July 14, the BEARISH regime returns without a China-approval-class reversal available. If SPX reclaims 7,520 with VIX declining below 15 and June CPI prints ≤3.5% on July 14, the structural bear case fails — the call is wrong.
